title: [AI][BACKEND] Watchlist and asset discovery API
summary: SQLite-backed watchlist CRUD with asset validation against market data layer and embedded quotes on list.
problems_solved: No persistence for user watchlist — discovery was stateless
Duplicate asset adds could create inconsistent rows — now idempotent POST returns 200
List endpoint did not include live/fallback quote — required N+1 client calls
context_for_future: Portfolio transactions should reject asset_ids not resolvable via market_data
Frontend watchlist page consumes GET /api/v1/watchlist with embedded quote
Single implicit watchlist per local instance — multi-user needs auth ADR
